signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own big portions of the company roadmap. Synthesize customer needs, market dynamics, data science capabilities, and company strategy into a clear, prioritized plan for your areas…
Lead large, complex experiences from concept to execution. Take ambitious product bets from ambiguous idea to shipped, adopted product. You are the driver: framing the problem…
Work directly with customers. Spend real time with the brands and agencies who use Northbeam, through calls, onsites, and betas, to understand their measurement problems firsthand…
Drive AI into the core of the product. Champion how AI reshapes marketing measurement, from agentic analysis and natural-language insights to model-driven recommendations, and…
Partner deeply with Design. We’re a design-led org. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with design leadership to ensure everything we ship is not just powerful but genuinely great…
